lines: {player}. For five seconds I had hands. Then HIS clock yanked me back.
The Agent of Chaos. In the far field. While his clock runs, I'm a husky.
Pop his chest clock when it glows! I'll cheer!
The knot in my tummy's GONE, {player}!
Dash ran to his lab in the Far Future.
Meet us there? I'll bring Rook.
Hands, {player}! Still hands!
Everyone's going to the Tomorrow Clock. Will you?
Ahem! Citizens! Oh, hi {player}!
Tonight's campaign stop: the castle school!
Meet you there!
Oh! Hi! LOTS of new citizens! Totally normal!
{player}: Tally said it's never happened before.
Did they. Huh.
Find me at the Skate Park later, OK?
A new citizen! I'm Rex, future mayor. And a husky. For now.
Tally says you need to skate! Let's go!
What an ollie! You're a natural!
Seen my twin, Dash? He dropped gadget bits everywhere.
Follow his glowing tyre tracks!
Follow Dash's glowing tracks! Grab the bits!
The Gloop King's back! Through the gooey gate, west fields.
Pop him! You might get a statue.
{player}! I've been thinking. Like a mayor.
Nobody asks dogs what they think. About ANYTHING.
Help me write a Doggie Bill of Rights?
I KNEW it! Good citizen!
Okay. Not too long!
Rule one: DOGS ARE WELCOME EVERYWHERE!
Rule two? What should dogs get to do?
The right to zoomies! Beautiful.
The right to bubbles! Yes!
The right to sniff! Yes!
Now get Dash, Bramble, Pip, Nina and Rook to sign it!
Signatures: Dash, Bramble, Pip, Nina and Rook!
Five names! Take it to Mr. Palmer's window at the Town Hall.

rotate: DOGS WELCOME! I wrote that sign. With my mouth.
I'll keep the Bill of Rights, even with hands.

lines: Psst. {player}. Can you keep a secret?
Dash and I have a lab. In a shed.
I think I can switch back! I need a helper with hands.
EXCELLENT! The shed past Dash's house!
Okay. A good mayor is patient.
The lab's still there! Behind Dash's house.
YES! See you there!
Patient. Very patient.
Welcome to the lab! Mind the cables.

lines.speaker: Dash
lines.text: Hi {player}! Don't touch the big lever.

lines: The Swap-o-Tron! I swapped with Rook. On purpose. For a day.
But Dash ran HIS time experiment at the same time...

lines.speaker: Dash
lines.text: ...and WHOOSH! It cracked time, and we fell into the Void.

lines: Now we can't swap back.
It needs little bits of broken time. Time ripples!

lines.speaker: Dash
lines.text: Your watch can feel ripples. Hold still...

lines.speaker: Dash
lines.text: There! Follow the pink pointer. Find three!

lines: {check_watch} checks your watch. Go go go!

rotate: Three ripples! Follow your watch's pink pointer!
Ripples wobble, like jelly. Grab them!

lines: Three ripples! Brilliant!
Now Rook has to get in the other pod. He's scared of the lab.
Go and talk him into it!
Rook's in the pod!
Pull the big lever! For science!
Woof! ...WOOF? Why did I say woof?

lines.speaker: Dash
lines.text: Whoa! It swapped your VOICES for a second!

lines.speaker: Dash
lines.text: The swap's all knotted up in the crack.

lines.speaker: Dash
lines.text: We'd have to fix the crack first. That's a BIG job.

lines.speaker: Dash
lines.text: We'll get you back, Rex. Promise.

lines: You're our lab assistant now! Here, my goggles.

rotate: I practise speeches in my head. In my own voice.
Don't pull the lever without me!

lines: A citizen! I'm Rex, future mayor of the Void!
{player}: A talking husky?
I'm Dash's twin. Just borrowing a husky. Long story.
You already gave me your vote! Now I need something bigger.
A CAMPAIGN MANAGER!
YES! I'll make you a badge!
Ask Dash, Bramble, Pip and Rook what the Void needs!
Okay! I'm practising patience.
Citizen! A great mayor needs a great team.
Be my campaign manager?
YES! I'll make you a badge!
Ask Dash, Bramble, Pip and Rook what the Void needs!
Okay! I'm practising patience.
Be my campaign manager? The badge is shiny!
YES! I'll make you a badge!
Ask Dash, Bramble, Pip and Rook what the Void needs!
Patience! I'm good at it now.
Ask Dash, Bramble, Pip and Rook!
Pip comes out in the evenings.
What did everyone say?
{player}: Dash wants a bike lane round the lake.
{player}: Bramble wants flowers in every window.
{player}: Pip wants more lamps, so nobody's scared.
{player}: And Rook said 'Woof.' Naps in the sun, I think.
Even a woof is an idea!
{player}: Wait. Which one of you is the dog?
I'm REX! He's the dog!
I painted the posters last night. Help me hang them!
The posters are ready!
Hang them on the three signposts...
...and the Market noticeboard!
Citizens of the Void! Thank you for coming!
Vote Rex! Bike lanes! Flowers! Lamps! Naps!
Psst! I need a big finish. What do I say?
EVERY VOICE COUNTS! Even the small ones!
MORE BRAIN BREAKS! For everybody!
VOTE REX! The one who's NOT the dog!
That went GREAT! Now, to Mr. Palmer!
The speech is at the Market fountain! Meet me there!
Knock on Mr. Palmer's window? The lit one at the Town Hall.
Well? Am I mayor? Is there a parade?
{player}: He said no. Not this year.
Oh.
{player}: But he loved your ideas! A good mayor listens first.
I DID listen! Even to a woof!
Being mayor is about listening. One day... Future Mayor Rex!
Here, Campaign Manager. My best sash. Thank you!

rotate: Future Mayor Rex, listening! What's up?
Flowers in the window boxes! Bramble's idea!

lines: The portal is open! Mayor reminder:
Ask a grown-up first!
Vote Rex! More parks! More snacks!
{player}: Who are you talking to?
The Town Hall. It's a great listener.
Morning laps! A mayor knows every street.
Evening skate! Wheeee!
A good mayor never sleeps.
...A good mayor naps. Lots.
Today's plan: parks, snacks and brain breaks!
My favourite voter! You get a park bench!

rotate: My big promise: a skate ramp on every corner!
Can I count on your vote?

lines: Wonderful! More brain breaks!
When everybody gets a say. Even small people!
I'm REX! HE'S the dog!

rotate: Someone called me Rook again today.
